mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN AS identityVerifiedYn FROM HM_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, IDENTITY_VERIFIED_YN AS identityVerifiedYn FROM HM_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HM_CLUB C INNER JOIN HM_CLUB_MEMBER CM ON CM.CLUB_ID = C.CLUB_ID AND CM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CM.CLUB_ROLE = 'LEADER' AND CM.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE C.CLUB_STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED')
SELECT CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName FROM HM_CATEGORY WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER, CATEGORY_NAME
mapper.sql: INNER JOIN HM_CATEGORY CAT ON CAT.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN HM_MEMBER LEADER ON LEADER.MEMBER_ID = C.OWNER_MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CLUB_ID, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM HM_CLUB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY CLUB_ID ) ACTIVE_MEMBERS ON ACTIVE_MEMBERS.CLUB_ID = C.CLUB_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT C.CLUB_ID AS clubId, C.REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL AS representativeImageUrl, C.CLUB_NAME AS clubName, CAT.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, C.ACTIVITY_REGION AS activityRegion, C.CLUB_SUMMARY AS clubSummary, C.GENDER_POLICY AS genderPolicy, C.MIN_AGE AS minAge, C.MAX_AGE AS maxAge, COALESCE(ACTIVE_MEMBERS.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS memberCount, C.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT AS maxMemberCount, C.RECRUIT_STATUS AS recruitStatus, C.JOIN_TYPE AS joinType, LEADER.NICKNAME AS leaderNickname, C.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT AS lastActivityAt, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM HM_CLUB C
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.CLUB_ID DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(ACTIVE_MEMBERS.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) DESC, C.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT DESC, C.CLUB_ID DESC
ORDER BY (C.MAX_MEMBER_COUNT - COALESCE(ACTIVE_MEMBERS.MEMBER_COUNT, 0)) DESC, C.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT DESC, C.CLUB_ID DESC
ORDER BY C.CLUB_NAME ASC, C.CLUB_ID DESC
ORDER BY C.LAST_ACTIVITY_AT DESC, C.CLUB_ID DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HM_CLUB ( OWNER_MEMBER_ID, CATEGORY_ID, CLUB_NAME, CLUB_SUMMARY, CLUB_DESCRIPTION, REPRESENTATIVE_IMAGE_URL, ACTIVITY_REGION, GENDER_POLICY, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MEMBER_COUNT, JOIN_TYPE, JOIN_GUIDE, CLUB_STATUS, RECRUIT_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{ownerMemberId}, #{categoryId}, #{clubName}, #{clubSummary}, #{clubDescription}, #{representativeImageUrl}, #{activityRegion}, #{genderPolicy}, #{minAge}, #{maxAge}, #{maxMemberCount}, #{joinType}, #{joinGuide}, 'ACTIVE', 'OPEN' )
INSERT INTO HM_CLUB_MEMBER ( CLUB_ID, MEMBER_ID, CLUB_ROLE, MEMBER_STATUS, JOINED_AT ) VALUES ( #{clubId}, #{memberId}, 'LEADER', 'ACTIVE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
